description: A company's quarterly figures as printed in the earnings release it furnished to the SEC (Form 8-K item 2.02, Exhibit 99): status (not_reported, filed_pending, reported), the expected filing window before the filing, the filing (accession, filedAt in UTC, exhibit URLs), each figure as printed with its unit, scale, line label and location, and changes against the prior quarter and the same quarter a year earlier. EPS is diluted GAAP. No forecasts or consensus. Covers AAPL, AMD, AMZN, BAC, C, COIN, DIS, F, GOOGL, HOOD, INTC, JPM, MARA, META, MSFT, NFLX, NVDA, PLTR, SMCI, SOFI, SPCX, TGT, TSLA.

all.description: Return the issuer with every quarter on record instead of one quarter

quarter.description: The company's own fiscal label, fy<year>-q<n> (e.g. "fy2027-q3" for NVIDIA's quarter ended October 2026), or "latest" (default) or "next"; omit with all=true for every quarter
